description: This file is a test script that manages test execution for a project, utilizing external libraries to spawn test processes, manage environment locks, and clean up temporary files. It orchestrates the running of Vitest test suites with support for command-line arguments and environment setup.

methods.name: releaseLockOnce
methods.description: Ensures the lock acquirement is released only once.

methods.name: cleanupVitestRunSpec
methods.description: Removes the include file associated with a test spec if it exists.

methods.name: runVitestSpec
methods.description: Runs a Vitest specification by spawning a process with specified arguments and environment, and handles cleanup after execution.

methods.name: createRootVitestRunSpec
methods.description: Creates the default root test specification based on command-line arguments.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main async function that orchestrates the test execution process based on parsed arguments.
